title: Is It Criminal Mischief?
summary: Damage or tampering, and how the dollar amount sets the grade.
note: Helps you find the right statute to read. It does not replace the statute, your prosecutor's guidance or department policy. Not yet verified against official sources.

owner.q: Did the property belong to someone other than the suspect?
owner.help: Jointly owned property can still count. A spouse breaking shared property is a common DV mischief case.

mental.q: Was the damage done purposely or knowingly, or recklessly or negligently with fire, explosives or another dangerous means?

tamper.q: Did the suspect tamper with the property in a way that endangers a person or property?

value2k.help: Use the repair or replacement cost. Get an estimate or receipt for the report.
